scenes.head: Will the bank lend on your *assets* or your cash?

lines.say: Will a bank lend against your assets, or against your cash flow?

scenes.myth: The *asset* is the safety: stock, receivables, property.
scenes.fact: The *cash* the business makes repays the loan.
scenes.src: Our view. Each bank sets its own criteria; check your facility letter.

lines.say: Asset-backed lending leans on what you own: stock, receivables or property.
Cash-flow lending leans on the cash your business generates to repay.
